raw_bindings.title: A contrast marker selects between explicitly opposed alternatives

design.contrast: explicit alternative pair with candidate versus matched paired fields without candidate
design.falsifier: No held alternative-structure contrast, or alternatives are not mutually exclusive under a blinded coding rule, falsifies the contrast mechanism.
design.mechanism: The candidate introduces or scopes an opposition whose two alternatives remain separately typed.
design.prediction: Candidate contexts show higher rates of mutually exclusive alternative structures and polarity reversal across the two fields; a generic connector predicts no alternative interaction.
design.related: Not negative-context exclusion, polarity retuning, or simple adjacency counting; alternatives must be predeclared
design.scope: cached paired fields only; endpoint availability_unknown for independent opposition coding
design.unit: candidate occurrences with two bounded alternative fields in the same record

raw_bindings.title: A coordination marker scopes over a multi-item list

design.contrast: candidate-bearing multi-item list versus matched adjacent item sequences without shared-predicate structure
design.falsifier: No held shared-predicate contrast, or list grouping depends on a single segmentation choice, falsifies the coordination mechanism.
design.mechanism: The candidate contributes coordination scope over a bounded list and leaves each item independently typed.
design.prediction: Candidate contexts show repeated shared-predicate/list structures and fewer independent predicate assignments; an item-noun model predicts no scope shift.
design.related: Distinct from amount frames, part cooccurrence, and role-position interaction; no quantity meaning is assumed
design.scope: cached bounded fields; endpoint availability_unknown for independent list-scope annotation
design.unit: candidate occurrences with two or more independently typed neighboring items and a shared predicate

evidence.quote:
Neither okol nor otedy is semantically named. Neither a same-paragraph sequence
nor proximity establishes reference, a part-whole relation or picture ownership.
There are other possible antecedents. qokain, solkeey and ychey remain unknown,
not conveniently supplied root/leaf/seed nouns. GDT811 already documented the
first two label/prose identities. The f77r target is not the nearest paragraph
to the upper labels. Full context and variants: src/TEXT_REFERENT_AUDIT.md.

Der relative Vorteil von „wenn“ gegenüber dem ausdrücklich rechtsgerichteten
präpositionalen „mit + nominaler Ergänzung“ auf f81r.19 hängt weiterhin daran,
dass `chedy` wirklich finit wäre. Die Aufnahme bestätigt diese Wortart nicht.
Die tatsächlichen Doubletten sind gerade ein Grund, die Finite-Verb-Annahme
nicht aus dem gut klingenden Einzelsatz auf den ganzen Text zu übertragen.

decisions.reason: The design explicitly selects opposed alternatives; an exclusive-branch variant may legitimately require exclusivity. However a generic connector can occur between independently opposed alternatives, so the asserted no-interaction null does not follow from that rival. Candidate-versus-control contrast must not be defined by the semantic outcome itself. Failure of exclusivity rejects only the predeclared exclusive variant, not contrast marking generally.
decisions.reopening: Freeze exclusive, scalar or corrective opposition and the generic-connector rival before annotation. Define contexts independently of the outcome, allow the rival its declared content/discourse associations, and state the candidate-dependent prediction that differs after matching. Specify held units, detectable effect and power. Supply independent scope/opposition bindings rather than inherited component glosses.

decisions.reason: The actual design is restricted to multi-item lists under a shared predicate; examples of clause coordination do not refute that restricted mechanism. Its selected unit already requires a shared predicate, while its comparator lacks shared-predicate structure, risking outcome-conditioned selection. An item noun can occur in such lists, so a no-scope-association prediction does not follow from the noun rival. Boundary sensitivity blocks the proposed measurement, not coordination in general.
decisions.reopening: Freeze an independently justified parse or explicit alternative parses and the candidate inventory before selecting by list outcome. Declare how the list-coordinator and item-noun models differ after allowing noun participation in lists. Use held data with a discriminating candidate-position/scope prediction and adequate power. Resolve source-group uncertainty or preserve it without treating one convenient segmentation as semantic gold.

root_peer_corrections: IDEA31 already mentions mutually exclusive alternatives. Exclusivity is not wholly unannounced; scalar counterexamples delimit a broader contrast claim but do not refute a defined exclusive-branch mechanism.
IDEA32 explicitly concerns a shared-predicate multi-item list. Clause-coordination examples are outside that scope and are not accepted as falsifiers of the restricted proposal.
The accepted design objection is the unjustified rival-null prediction and risk of selecting on the tested outcome, plus missing independent annotation. No new manuscript data was scored.
Root inspected GDT815/819 and peer GDT428/429 excerpts: four reports across two independent screens. The initial note estimated two; no source or corpus search was expanded beyond those four.

ordinary_language_logic_checks.example: Take tea or coffee; tea and coffee are the available alternatives.
ordinary_language_logic_checks.point: A generic and can join the names of alternatives; their opposition can be supplied by context. This is a counterexample to a universal no-association rival, not evidence about a Voynich word.
Salt is an item noun in a shared-predicate list. Its list association does not make it a coordinator; the model must discriminate structural positions or scope independently.
